title: Senior Engineer-Device Driver
description: Engineered for Speed. Built for Global Scale. Hexnode is a global force in Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) and cybersecurity, trusted in 100+ countries to secure millions of devices across Apple, Windows, Android, macOS, Linux, and tvOS. Evolving rapidly into a comprehensive platform encompassing XDR, IdP, and DEX, we maintain an industry-leading release pace of 100+ features annually. We combine the momentum of a hyper-growth company with the mission-critical impact of an enterprise leader. THE ROLE We are seeking a Senior Windows Device Driver Engineer for our Windows Kernel Development team to build, debug, and maintain kernel-mode drivers and user-mode components. This role requires strong hands-on expertise in Windows internals and low-level debugging, and is expected to grow into technical leadership—mentoring engineers and owning a component end-to-end—while remaining primarily an individual contributor. You will work closely with a Windows Kernel Development team based in Chennai, own a driver component or feature area, and collaborate across QA, product, and support to ship production-grade driver code. If you have strong hands-on Windows driver experience and are ready to start taking on technical leadership, we want you on this team. Responsibilities Design, implement, and maintain Windows kernel-mode drivers, user-mode components (e.g., mini-filters, WFP network callouts, WDF function drivers). Debug complex, low-level issues such as crash dumps, BSODs, race conditions, and IRQL violations, using tools like WinDbg. Own a driver component or feature area end-to-end, from design through shipping and support. Build and maintain the user-mode components around your driver, including services, DLLs, and COM interfaces, primarily in C/C++. Participate in code reviews, help onboard and mentor less experienced engineers, and contribute to technical design decisions for your team. Work with QA/test to ensure driver stability and, where applicable, support certification processes (WHQL/HLK). Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, QA, support) to translate requirements into robust, production-ready driver code. Required Skills And Qualifications 5-8 years of professional software engineering experience, with hands-on Windows Systems/Kernel Development. Hands-on experience building or maintaining Windows kernel-mode drivers and/or user-mode components (KMDF, WDM, WDF, UMDF, mini-filter, WFP, or similar). Strong C and/or C++ skills at a systems level (primary language requirement), with C# as a secondary language (e.g., tooling, services, test harnesses). Solid understanding of Windows internals (memory management, process/thread scheduling, IRQL, synchronization). Experience with WinDbg or equivalent kernel debugging tools, and comfort reading crash dumps. Some early leadership signal: you've owned a module or feature, mentored a teammate, or acted as the de facto technical lead on something. Nice-to-have: experience with file-system mini-filters or WFP network drivers, driver signing/WHQL/HLK exposure, user-mode systems experience (Windows services, DLLs, COM), or endpoint security related technologies. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related discipline. Hexnode is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences to apply. Benefits Comprehensive Healthcare Insurance Flexible Time Off Wellness Programs Professional Development Opportunities Generous Leave Policies
